mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS targetUserId, u.real_name AS targetName, u.avatar AS targetAvatar, p.id AS productId, p.title AS productTitle, p.images AS productImage, p.status AS productStatus, latest.content AS lastMessage, latest.create_time AS lastTime, IFNULL(unread.cnt, 0) AS unreadCount FROM ( SELECT t.target_user_id, t.product_id, t.content, t.create_time FROM ( SELECT cm.*, IF(cm.sender_id = #{currentUserId}, cm.receiver_id, cm.sender_id) AS target_user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY IF(cm.sender_id = #{currentUserId}, cm.receiver_id, cm.sender_id), cm.product_id ORDER BY cm.create_time DESC ) AS rn FROM chat_message cm WHERE cm.sender_id = #{currentUserId} OR cm.receiver_id = #{currentUserId} ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 ) latest LEFT JOIN user u ON latest.target_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN product p ON latest.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT IF(sender_id = #{currentUserId}, receiver_id, sender_id) AS target_user_id, product_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM chat_message WHERE receiver_id = #{currentUserId} AND is_read = 0 GROUP BY target_user_id, product_id ) unread ON unread.target_user_id = latest.target_user_id AND unread.product_id = latest.product_id ORDER BY latest.create_time DESC

SELECT cm.id, cm.product_id, cm.sender_id, cm.receiver_id, cm.content, cm.is_read, cm.message_type, cm.create_time, u.real_name AS senderName, u.avatar AS senderAvatar FROM chat_message cm LEFT JOIN user u ON cm.sender_id = u.id WHERE cm.product_id = #{productId} AND ( (cm.sender_id = #{currentUserId} AND cm.receiver_id = #{targetUserId}) OR (cm.sender_id = #{targetUserId} AND cm.receiver_id = #{currentUserId}) ) ORDER BY cm.create_time DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE receiver_id = #{currentUserId} AND is_read = 0
